notes.title: SORRY. We are solving some mistakes:
notes.content:
We are very sorry for the inconveniences which is causing the executable that was uploaded and we are working on it to do it better.

- We had changed some part of the code before upload it to make it easy and accessible deleting certain functions, in addition to the changes made for the first feedbacks, we have detected some errors in controls that we are solving.

- Also, we modified the map recently to reduce polygons and we are finding some errors on the colliders.

[b]We hope you can forgive the mistakes. We are working every day from dawn to repair it. We are sure that C.S.S. CITADEL VR is a great game and we are going to show it.[/b]

It will be ready again in a few days. We will keep you update.
